correctness.rationale: Integral proof reconstructed. A finite tree has MH_{k,k}=Z^{2e} and no off-diagonal magnitude homology, citing inspected Asao–Izumihara Theorem 3.6. The first length-drop differential on alternating edge words has the displayed rank-one 2x2 blocks; at degree one the tree incidence matrix has rank n−1. No higher page differential can meet the diagonal, giving explicit primitive edge cycles and only H_L=Z^e. At level two the backtrack and length-two-path 2-cells kill pi1, and Hurewicz/Whitehead upgrades to a sphere wedge. A vertex-free involution reverses one central edge and pairs all other edges; its action is free on ordered nondegenerate simplices. The central-edge two-point nerve is the L-skeletal EG model with antipodal sphere action, orbit RP^L. Its H_L image is a primitive edge basis line and the relative integral homology is s free Z[C2] regular summands. Based L-spheres represent orbit-basis classes, and the equivariant map from the central sphere plus free sphere orbits is an integral homology equivalence of simply connected covers; Whitehead yields the quotient wedge formula. The L=1 quotient is a graph handled separately. Finite checker reproduces all 138 modular predictions for branching and nonbranching trees; these computations corroborate but do not establish the general result.

originality.rationale: The claim is not merely the known tree magnitude diagonality: it identifies an integral Aut(T)-module by explicit primitive cycles, and proves the genuine geometric quotient homotopy type RP^L wedge s L-spheres for every free involution of any finite tree. Previously available magnitude homology plus spectral-sequence technology supplies the nonequivariant calculation but does not itself determine the geometric quotient or its homotopy type. Direct full-text comparison with the 2026 Melodia length-filtration preprint abstract and full-text older foundational nerve paper and related 2026 ordered l1-Rips treatment showed no covering quotient theorem. Publicly indexed related symmetry-quotient findings concern distinct complexes and lack a reduction. Priority remains conditional on unindexed equivalents. Melodia full text was not accessible in this review; this is a residual risk, not a negative full-document claim.

value.rationale: Genuine geometric quotients of an ordered metric-length filtration carry nontrivial 2-torsion invisible in the simply connected covering wedges. The exact RP^L wedge splitting works for every centrally reversed branching tree and every positive integer scale, determines homotopy not just ranks, and gives an explicit integral automorphism character. This is a natural exact equivariant classification motivated by the latest enriched-nerve construction, with potential use distinguishing symmetry-aware filtered metric topologies. Its nonequivariant component is known-derived and is not presented as the sole novel contribution.
